note: Frozen BEFORE the holdout run. No parameter is tuned; candidates A and B use textbook parameters; C is the previously frozen PR#198 rule kept as benchmark.
data: staged RAW canonical bars (NOT adjusted); symbols/windows with an unresolved >11.5% close-to-close move (possible unrecorded corporate action) excluded symmetrically; bars are mostly single-provider non-official
universe: ADV20 >= 1,000,000 EGP at signal; position cap 5% of ADV20 (trade skipped above); 250,000 EGP per position
execution: signal at close t; entry at CLOSE of t+1 (official/auction 'open' never used); exits evaluated at closes

A_breakout55.exit: first close < min(low_{t-20..t-1}) (lowest low of the 20 sessions before the evaluated day), or 60 sessions

B_xsmom63.entry: last session of each month: rank return close_{t-5}/close_{t-68}-1 among eligible symbols, top decile (min 3 names)

C_ma20_pullback.entry: PR#198 frozen rule via walkforward.signals (limit at MA20, stop=min last-10 closes, T1=entry+1.5R, <=20 sessions)

selection_rule: on development only: candidate with the highest 95% month-cluster-bootstrap LOWER bound of mean net return per trade, provided it is > 0 and n >= 200; otherwise NO candidate is selected
pass_rule_holdout: selected candidate must have n >= 200, mean net > 0, bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and positive mean net in >= 3 of the 4 half-year buckets of the holdout
interpretation: PASS only licenses further independent validation (official data, adjusted series, paper trading). It never produces an executable recommendation by itself.
